select * from ( select rpi.prod_id prod_id, rpi.prod_name prod_name, rpi.prod_re reg_code, rpi.raise_type raise_type, dpa.adj_reason adjustReason, dpa.prod_adj_remark remark1, dpa.prod_adj_remark2 remark2 from rep_prod_info rpi inner join dis_prod_adjust dpa on rpi.prod_re = dpa.prod_regist_no and dpa.data_status = 'E' AND dpa.rpt_issue_date = #{rptIssueDate} where rpi.prod_id = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and rpi.status = 'E'
AND dpa.adj_field in ( select distinct adj_field from dis_prod_adjust t where t.prod_adjust_id in
#{item,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
order by dpa.eff_date ) where rownum = 1

select listagg(rpi.prod_id, ',') within group(order by rpi.prod_id) prod_id, dpa.adj_field adj_field, rpi.raise_type raise_type, min(dpa.eff_date) eff_date, max(dpa.adj_reason) adjustReason, max(dpa.field_adj_remark) remark1, max(dpa.field_adj_remark2) remark2 from rep_prod_info rpi inner join dis_prod_adjust dpa on rpi.prod_re = dpa.prod_regist_no and dpa.data_status = 'E' AND dpa.rpt_issue_date = #{rptIssueDate} where dpa.adj_field = (select adj_field from dis_prod_adjust t where t.prod_adjust_id = #{adjField,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) and rpi.status = 'E'
AND rpi.prod_id in
#{item,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
group by dpa.adj_field, rpi.raise_type

AND dpa.adj_field in ( select distinct adj_field from dis_prod_adjust t where t.prod_adjust_id in
#{item,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
